Spike Saunders, the Goliath of fWO, Callie Urban and Jade Argent'; the held record's members are the same three merged records, ACW 18 March to 28 October 2010, and ACW's card for Spike Saunders names The Entourage and fWo (as the verified reading records). It is not the-entourage-epw's team (a different team of 2005). The fed's own appearance record carries it on eight cards from 10 October 2009 to 31 December 2009.
